title: Boop Utils
description: A Simple Collections of Boop Utilities for some Hypixel Sillies :3
body:
# **Hello**~~wo~~
Tis' A simple mod that does `/boop` only, for a healthy amount of Hypixel sillies\
Finally written a **LEGIT** mod that's not just datapack + resource pack :3

## Features
1. Automatically `/Boop` the Configured player upon entering a world
2. Automatically `/Boop` any `Friend` and / or `Guild` Member joined
3. Automatically `/Boop` back anyone who `/Boop`-ed you

## Config
You can install the [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) for an easier config menu.\
Alternatively, type `/booputils` command in game to configure:
- `main [enable/disable]`: Whether to completely enable / disable all of this mod's functions
- `boopOnStartUp [true/false]`: Whether to send `/Boop` everytime you enter a world
- `startUpDelay [get/set] <StartUpDelay>`: Get / Set the tick delay before `/Boop` after you enter a world
- `target [get/set] <PlayerName>`: Get / Set the target player (to Boop)
- `delay [get/set] <TickDelay>`: Get / Set the tick delay before sending `/Boop` after detecting a target
- `retaliate [true/false]`: Whether to retaliate against any incoming Booper
- `friend [true/false]`: Whether to include all `Friend` in target
- `guild [true/false]`: Whether to include all `guild` member in target

## Problems
1. `You cannot say the same message twice!` :(
2. idk how to distinguish Hypixel server world from any other worlds, so the `BoopOnStartUp` triggers literally every time
